examples.title: Certificate — static one-pager
examples.description: Plain text, a fixed table and simple {{ variables }} on an absolutely-positioned A4 landscape sheet. The gentlest introduction.

examples.title: Invoice — table that flows across pages
examples.description: A {% for %} table with a repeating header, a conditional discount row that only appears when the field is set, page numbers from CSS counters, and totals the consumer computes.

examples.title: Application form — comb fields
examples.description: One box per character of an id (the character-cells preset), rows padded to a fixed count, and checkboxes driven by booleans. A synthetic form, not a real one.

examples.title: Report — background, header/footer, codes
examples.description: A full-bleed page background, a header and footer that repeat on every page, page numbers, and a scannable QR and barcode drawn by the server.

examples.title: Status matrix — coloured cells
examples.description: A table where each cell carries its own background and text colour — the two-palette cell styling, shown as a status grid.

examples.title: Shipping label — fixed-size media
examples.description: A compact fixed label with a QR for lookup and a Code128 barcode, each sized in exact millimetres.
